Implicit surfaces - paulbourke.net
Bloomenthal has discussed techniques for modelling organic forms (trees, leaves, arms) using blobby techniques (though he prefers the term "implicit modelling") and for polygonizing these using adaptive, surface-tracking octrees. The latter algorithm is not limited to blobby models, but works for any implicit model, not just blobs.
